args.question: Why does the antenna miss the 2.4 GHz band and what would fix it?

suspects.title: Antenna length
suspects.why: The deepest dip may sit away from the band.

suspects.title: Matching network
suspects.why: The impedance at the band centre may be inductive.
suspects.test: Try other series and shunt parts.

suspects.title: Nearby copper
suspects.why: Ground copper next to the feed can detune the antenna.
suspects.test: Clear a small region next to the feed.

args.label: clear the copper next to the feed

args.reasoning: Clearing the copper improves the worst in-band S11 by 9.3 dB compared with the base run.

args.title: Ground copper next to the feed detunes the antenna
args.what: In the screen comparison, clearing the copper next to the antenna feed improves the worst in-band S11 by 9.3 dB against the base.
args.why_it_matters: A detuned antenna wastes transmit power.
args.recommendation: Review the ground copper next to the antenna feed in your own tool.

args.summary: Clearing the copper improves the in-band result by 9.3 dB in the screen comparison.

thought: The confirm run missed the target, so the refine round should try shortening together with matching, which was not tried yet.

args.label: shorten the antenna
args.reason: The confirm base E-003 and the confirm winner E-004 are inconclusive for the copper clearing, and the band centre stays inductive, so the antenna is still too long for the band: shorten it and try matching on it.

args.title: Shortening the antenna with a series capacitor brings the band within the target in simulation
args.what: At confirm quality the first attempt, clearing the copper next to the feed, did not hold. The refine attempt, shortening the antenna by 7 mm together with the matching parts, gives a worst in-band S11 of -12.9 dB against -2.9 dB for the base.
args.why_it_matters: The antenna is detuned as built, so range suffers.
args.recommendation: Apply in your own tool, then re-measure: shorten the antenna by 7 mm and replace L1 with 0.75 pF, as tested in simulation.

args.summary: The first fix, clearing copper, did not hold at confirm quality. Shortening the antenna with matching met the target at confirm quality in simulation.
top_actions: Apply the shortening and the L1 change in your own tool and re-measure (F-001).
